jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
jobs.description:
Are you ready to work night shifts and do you already have some experience as an order picker? Then this is your chance!

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

What will you do?
? Collect and prepare orders like a true professional
? Work with a high order-picking truck (no fear of heights!)
? Grow step by step thanks to internal training

Your work schedule:
Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full-time or part-time. For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker
?? No fear of heights and good physical condition
?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English
?? Strong numerical skills, attention to detail and spatial awareness

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association. 
 
• bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository. 
 
• bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects. 
 
• bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback. 
 
• bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department. 
 
• bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases. 
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

jobs.occupation: Production worker 2 shifts physical work close to Roeselare// High payment above 17euro's per hour
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a hands-on job in a growing company within the plastics industry? Do you enjoy physical work and being part of a team? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

To support a major new project, we are looking for motivated and committed Production Workers to join the shipping department.

Your responsibilities will include:

 
• Assisting with the assembly of wooden crates used for packaging and shipping products.
 
• Working together with a colleague to stack and assemble the crate components using an ergonomic support system.
 
• Carefully packing finished automotive parts into the crates.
 
• Securing the products properly, closing the crates with lids and straps, and preparing them for shipment.
 
• Attaching the correct shipping labels to the finished crates.

 
• You are motivated, reliable, and eager to work.
 
• You are comfortable performing physically demanding tasks.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy working in a team environment.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system.
 
• Experience in production or logistics is an asset but not required.

Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to three C-levels, allowing them to focus on strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing calendars and organizing meetings.
• Coordinating business travel arrangements.
• Preparing and formatting presentations, reports and other business documents.
• Supporting leadership meetings, events and training sessions.
• Anticipating executives' needs and ensuring smooth follow-up on key actions.
• Providing ad hoc administrative support on strategic initiatives.

• You are looking for a first experience or already have a few years of experience as Management Assistant or Executive Assistant.
• You are fluent in French and English, with a good understanding of Dutch.
• You are organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• You are comfortable working autonomously and taking initiative.
• You communicate professionally and confidently with senior stakeholders.
• You are flexible, service-oriented and eager to learn.

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
• +10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French or Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

We are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Maintaining close communication with the operator

• Other related tasks

What we expect from you:

• You have previous experience in a production environment or are willing to learn, and you can work flexibly in a three-shift system (morning, late and night shift).

• You are comfortable performing physical work at a steady pace.

• You have a good command of Dutch or English to understand safety instructions.

• You can travel independently to Dendermonde each day, as the company is located in an industrial zone and is not accessible by public transport.

• You are looking for long-term employment and are willing to complete a 2-hour packing test after a successful interview.
